name: 高山陣屋
what: 江戸幕府が飛騨を治めた役所の跡で、国の史跡。当時の主な建物が残る、全国でただ一つの代官・郡代所。
whatEn: The office from which the Edo shogunate governed Hida, a national historic site, and the only one of its kind whose main buildings survive.

name: 三町の古い町並
what: 江戸時代の城下町の商人町。出格子の町家が並ぶ三筋の通りは、国の重要伝統的建造物群保存地区。
whatEn: The merchant quarter of the Edo-period castle town. Its three streets of latticed townhouses are a national preservation district for groups of traditional buildings.

name: 宮川朝市
what: 宮川沿いに白いテントが並ぶ朝市。野菜や漬物、民芸品。1960年からこの河川敷で開く。毎日7時から12時（12〜3月は8時から）。
whatEn: A morning market of white tents along the Miyagawa: vegetables, pickles, folk crafts. Held on this riverbank since 1960, daily 7:00–12:00 (from 8:00, December to March).

name: 日下部民藝館
what: 代官所の御用商人だった日下部家の町家。明治12年に建て直され、国の重要文化財。土蔵で渋草焼などの民藝品を見せる。火曜は休み。
whatEn: The townhouse of the Kusakabe, merchants to the Edo-era magistrate's office, rebuilt in 1879 and a national Important Cultural Property. Its storehouses show folk crafts such as Shibukusa ware. Closed Tuesdays.
